verdict.rationale: Headless, compute-only use in automated pipelines is a fair axis for a GPU. The evidence only implies it. The CUDA toolkit supports building and deploying apps across workstations, data centers and cloud platforms. MIG can split the Max-Q variant into up to four isolated instances, which suits shared or automated workloads. A community multi-card build runs sustained inference at 41k tok/s. Nothing explicitly documents headless or display-less operation or CI integration. Missing for 10: explicit headless/compute-mode documentation, CI runner or container (e.g. GPU-in-Docker) guidance, scriptable management tooling evidence, independent hands-on reports of CI/automation use.
